messages.subject: Select verb on grouped_df
parts:
Hi everyone,

I would like first to thank Hadley and Romain for excellent package 'dplyr'.
I was playing with manip verbs (filter, select, etc) and I experienced an error with select.

require(dplyr) ## latest version

group_by(mtcars, vs) %.% select(mpg)
Error: index out of bounds

str(group_by(mtcars, vs) %.% subset(select = mpg))
Classes ‘grouped_df’, ‘tbl_df’, ‘tbl’ and 'data.frame':    32 obs. of  1 variable:
 $ mpg: num  21 21 22.8 21.4 18.7 18.1 14.3 24.4 22.8 19.2 ...

It's a known issue or a desired feature of select ?

Thanks
